title: Mutation target reaches a crate outside the declared mutation scope
description: SA defect, Raise to SO: the pure core includes the pricing function (cost crate, zero vsdd-core imports) but the Phase 5 strategy scopes mutation to vsdd-core and mdatron-core only. Fix: the strategy line adds the cost crate, or states pricing's mutation coverage lives under the cost crate's boundary. [owner: solution-architect; validator: solution-owner]

comments.author: xqjG
